clauses.text: 2 - OPERATIVE CLAUSE If during the Policy Period one or more Insured Person (s) is required to be hospitalized for treatment of an Illness or Injury at a Hospital/ Day Care Centre, following Medical Advice of a duly qualiﬁed Medical Practitioner, the Company shall indemnify Medically necessary, expenses towards the Coverage mentioned in the Policy schedule.
